parsed.review_summary: The corrected rationale addresses all three error targets: (1) it correctly notes the evaluated comment has no locatable reference and thus authors cannot pinpoint the part, fixing the factual error; (2) it distinguishes the topical specificity of the issue from the lack of locational grounding, correcting the evidence misread and rubric misapplication; (3) it maps the comment to the rubric level where the part is not confidently identifiable but the requested action is clearly specified, correcting the score mapping error. The rationale preserves the valid observation about the comment's specificity of issue, does not invent evidence, and does not directly state a numeric score or gold label.
